question: At the qualified R20 actual-108 state, across every complement-normalized balanced binary partition of the sixteen phase values, is full-five-coordinate membership sufficiency for each phase-plus-one-derived-coordinate projection exactly equivalent to separating every antipodal phase pair q and q+8?
hypothesis: R20's exact odd/even alternation is caused by antipodal separation rather than transition count: all and only the 128 complement-normalized balanced partitions that separate every pair {q,q+8} will reproduce full-five-coordinate membership in all four derived-coordinate panels; the remaining 6307 partitions will reproduce none of those panels.

prior_evidence.observation: The frozen R20 matrix alternated exactly by fragmentation level: levels 1,3,5,7 each matched all 32 rotation-by-derived panels, levels 2,4,6,8 matched zero, with 128 total exact matches, no partial level, and three restorations after zero. Under the frozen formula, odd levels separate q from q+8 and even levels place them together.

scope_statement: This changes one R20 dimension: instead of the formula-generated transition-count spectrum, it exhaustively enumerates every balanced binary partition up to bucket-label complement and tests the preregistered antipodal-separation law. Actual-108 records, streams, seeds, binary cardinality, tuple width, four derived-coordinate panels, capacity, exact set equality, induction, and evaluator-only audit remain fixed. It makes no population, task-learning, natural-language, or deployment claim.
authority: research-only; no deployment, external-model inference, scheduler, queue, accepted-ref, production, broker, live-interface, CKB-plane, or cross-lane authority

arms_and_inputs.full_five_coordinate_control: Exact R20 actual-108 records represented by sorted exact sets of [phase_anchor,prefix0,prefix1,suffix0,suffix1].
arms_and_inputs.partition_enumeration: Enumerate masks 0..65535 in ascending order; retain exactly masks with popcount 8 and bit 0 equal to zero. Bit q is the bucket for phase index q=p-160. Fixing bit 0 removes the bucket-label complement and yields exactly 6435 unique unlabeled balanced partitions.
arms_and_inputs.antipodal_law: A retained partition is law-positive iff for every q in 0..7, bit(q) differs from bit(q+8). Exactly 128 retained partitions must be law-positive and 6307 law-negative.
arms_and_inputs.partition_panel: For each retained mask in ascending order, evaluate [bucket,prefix0], [bucket,prefix1], [bucket,suffix0], [bucket,suffix1], for exactly 25740 arms. Every arm uses identical actual-108 records; no source byte is mutated.
arms_and_inputs.r20_controls: Reconstruct all 64 R20 level-by-offset declared partitions, normalize each by complement so bit 0 is zero, and verify every corresponding R21 membership result. All 32 odd-level controls must match in all four panels and all 32 even-level controls must match in none; duplicate normalized masks remain declared controls.
arms_and_inputs.evaluation: Exact projected-support equality, class cardinality, class-membership comparison, and evaluator-only entity audit; no task model is trained.

seeds.all_arms: Exact R6-R20 independent seeds; exhaustive partition projection introduces no random draw.

controls: The local deterministic R20 probe must reproduce nonmonotone_fragmentation and its frozen exact level matrix before R21 output.
The full five-coordinate control must reproduce nine correct triplets with zero splits and zero cross-entity collisions.
Enumeration must produce exactly 6435 distinct popcount-eight masks with bit zero clear, including exactly 128 antipodal-separating and 6307 nonseparating masks.
Every retained mask must be balanced 8/8; complement normalization and independent mask reconstruction must agree.

All 64 R20 declared level-by-offset partitions must reconstruct through the R21 mask representation; their four-panel membership results must exactly reproduce R20, including declared duplicate/complement controls.

The complete 6435-by-four panel runs once in ascending mask then derived-coordinate order; entity and family labels are unavailable to projection and induction and enter only the post-induction audit.
validity_criteria: Exact parent and North Star identities match.
The local deterministic R20 probe reproduces its frozen classification and exact controls before R21 output.
All 25740 projections are constructed from identical actual-108 records with exactly one binary phase bucket and one declared derived coordinate.
The retained mask set is exactly the exhaustive complement-normalized balanced partition set, with exact declared positive and negative cardinalities.
Every arm has frozen cardinality, valid byte ranges, finite metrics, and exactly 36 unordered entity pairs audited.
Full Go regression passes before the probe.
No tokenizer, task training, external model, network call, capacity growth, fuzzy matching, seed search, adaptive arm selection, or evaluator leakage occurs.

classification_rules.antipodal_separation_iff_sufficient: Validity and controls pass; all 128 antipodal-separating partitions match all four derived-coordinate panels, all 6307 nonseparating partitions match zero panels, and both false-negative and false-positive partition counts are zero.
classification_rules.antipodal_separation_sufficient_not_nece: Validity and controls pass; every antipodal-separating partition matches all four panels with no partial or zero case, and at least one nonseparating partition matches one or more panels.
classification_rules.antipodal_separation_not_sufficient: Validity and controls pass; at least one antipodal-separating partition fails one or more panels.
classification_rules.mixed: Validity and controls pass but none of the preceding scientific rules applies.
classification_rules.negative_control_failure: Any frozen R20, full-five-coordinate, exhaustive-enumeration, balance, complement-normalization, uniqueness, or R20 reconstruction control fails.
classification_rules.incomplete: Compute interruption prevents the complete fixed 25740-arm panel.
classification_rules.invalid: Any identity, construction, enumeration-cardinality, arm-cardinality, projection, balance, uniqueness, leakage, evaluator-boundary, determinism, finite-metric, or qualification criterion fails.

stop_conditions: Stop invalid before science on identity, R20 replication, full-five-coordinate control, exhaustive enumeration, R20 reconstruction, build, or frozen-package drift.
After R21 output begins, complete all 25740 partition arms and frozen evaluations unless infrastructure prevents it.
Do not filter partitions, alter the mask or antipodal formulas, inspect alternate budgets, or change controls, metrics, thresholds, capacity, or classification after observing R21 output.
no_post_result_tuning_rule: No arm, partition, enumeration rule, antipodal law, derived coordinate, budget, context distribution, sample sequence, seed, representation rule, class learner, control, metric, threshold, capacity, stop condition, or interpretation may change after primary R21 output.
